newsitem.title: USA: HFS completes Avis buy, plans stock offering.
newsitem.headline: HFS completes Avis buy, plans stock offering.

text.p: HFS Inc. said Thursday that it completed its acquisition of Avis Inc., the world's second largest car rental company, for about $800 million.
HFS, a franchisor of hotels and residential real estate brokerage offices, also said it plans to pursue acquiring another car rental company.
The company said it expects to make an initial stock offering of its majority interest in Avis next year.
HFS hotel properties include Days Inn, Howard Johnson, Ramada and Super 8. It owns the Century 21, Coldwell Banker and ERA real estate brokers.
